head: TidyList: YouTube playlist organizer finds duplicates and deleted videos
dek: TidyList is a new web tool that lets you sort, filter and bulk-move videos between your YouTube playlists after signing in with Google. It also flags duplicate, private, removed and hidden videos so you can clear them in one go.
details: You can filter by category or search by title, then save the result as a new playlist or copy and move videos in bulk. Nothing changes on YouTube until you confirm. It has no ads and nothing to install; saving changes needs Pro, a one-time £4.99 payment that doesn't renew.
where: Web, with a Google sign-in; Pro £4.99 one-time
means: If your Watch Later or music playlists have grown into a mess of repeats and dead videos, this cleans them up faster than doing it one by one in YouTube.
todo: Try the free view to see what it finds in your playlists before paying for Pro to save changes.
